References

1. “Reactor Safety Study, An Assessment of Accident Risks in U.S. Commercial
Nuclear Power Plants," WASH-1400, NUREG-75/014 (Oct. 1975).

2. “HTGR Accident Initiation and Progression Analysis Status Report," GA-
13617 (Feb. 1976).

3. "CRBRP Risk Assessment Report," CRBRP-1 (March 1977).

4. H. H. Lewis et al., "Risk Assessment Group Report to the U. S. Nuclear
Regulatory Commission," NUREG/CR-0400 (Sept. 1978).

5. K. N. Fleming and P. H. Raabe, “A Comparison of Three Methods for the

6. R. C. Erdman et al., "WAMCUT: A Computer Code for Fault Tree Evaluation,"

7. R. B. Worrell, “Instructions for Using the SETS Program," SLA-73-0908A

8. K. M. Jamali and W. Kerr, "Quantification of Dependent Failures of High

12. J. Rasmussen, “Operator/Technician Errors in Calibration, Setting, and

13. G. Apostolakis and S. Kaplan, "Pitfalls in Risk Calculations," draft re-

14. D. Ilberg, "An Analysis of the Reliability of the Shutdown Heat Removal

15. A. J. Buslik, I. A. Papazoglou and R. A. Bari, “Reliability of the Shut-
down Heat Removal System of the CRBR," BNL-NUREG-21962 (Oct. 1976).
